events.summary: Speaker B presented the prototype: volume scroll on the left, channel buttons on the right, power key, menu key, infrared section, microphone and a cover with holes for the buttons.

events.quote: on the left we've got the scroll for the volume, on the right we have buttons for the channels up and down

events.quote: the covers will be that sort of rubbery material like they make iPod covers

events.speaker: B
events.quote: you should be able to stretch it over yourself and it'll be fine

events.speaker: D
events.quote: on a scale of one to seven, one being true and seven being being false
